reading.title: The Impact of Remote Work on Urban Development
reading.passage: Remote work has fundamentally transformed how cities develop and function. As companies embrace flexible work arrangements, fewer employees commute daily, reducing traffic congestion and pollution in urban centers. However, this shift creates challenges for city planners. Commercial real estate values decline when office spaces sit empty, threatening local tax revenues. Additionally, suburban areas experience rapid growth as workers relocate, straining infrastructure and services. Urban renewal requires adapting vacant buildings into residential spaces and community centers. Cities that successfully transition will prioritize mixed-use developments, promoting both residential and commercial integration.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one challenge that remote work creates for city planners?
options: Increased traffic congestion in downtown areas
Decline in commercial real estate values
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'Commercial real estate values decline when office spaces sit empty'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 이는 도시 계획자들이 직면하는 구체적인 문제입니다.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest cities should do to successfully transition?
questions.explanation: 'Cities that successfully transition will prioritize mixed-use developments'라는 문장에서 도시가 성공적으로 전환하기 위해 해야 할 일을 설명하고 있습니다.

questions.q: Which of the following is mentioned as a positive effect of remote work?
questions.explanation: 'fewer employees commute daily, reducing traffic congestion and pollution in urban centers'에서 원격 근무의 긍정적 효과를 찾을 수 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Remote work is better than working in a traditional office environment'?

structure.intro: 의견을 명확히 제시하되, 찬성 또는 반대 입장을 분명히 하고 2-3개의 주요 이유를 소개합니다.
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유를 구체적인 예시와 함께 설명합니다. 예: 유연성, 효율성, 생활의 질 향상 등
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유를 제시하고 상세히 전개합니다. 반대 주장에 대한 반박도 포함할 수 있습니다.
structure.conclusion: 주요 논점을 요약하고 최종 의견을 재확인하며 전체 주장을 강화합니다.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer working in a traditional office. Others prefer remote work. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer... because...
sample_points: 원격 근무는 통근 시간을 절약하고 개인 시간을 더 확보할 수 있으며, 유연한 일정으로 생산성을 높일 수 있습니다.
반면 사무실 근무는 동료와의 직접적인 상호작용, 팀 협력 강화, 그리고 업무 관계 구축에 장점이 있습니다.

listening.title: Professor's Lecture on Urban Planning
listening.script: Professor: Good morning, everyone. Today we'll discuss how cities are adapting to remote work trends. As you know, the pandemic accelerated remote work adoption significantly. Now, five years later, cities face both opportunities and challenges. On the positive side, reduced commuting means lower carbon emissions and less traffic congestion. Downtown areas have become more pedestrian-friendly with improved public spaces. However, traditional office districts are struggling. Landlords face vacant buildings, and local governments lose tax revenue from commercial properties. Some cities are being proactive. They're converting empty office buildings into apartments, co-working spaces, and cultural centers. For example, San Francisco and New York have launched programs to revitalize downtown areas through mixed-use development. The key to success is planning ahead. Cities that adapt quickly will attract both residents and businesses. Those that don't risk economic decline. Urban planners must balance growth with sustainability.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the lecture?
options: How to reduce carbon emissions in cities
How cities are adapting to remote work trends
The history of commercial real estate
Why remote work is harmful to cities
questions.explanation: 교수는 'Today we'll discuss how cities are adapting to remote work trends'라고 명시했습니다. 이것이 강의의 주요 주제입니다.

questions.q: According to the professor, what are cities doing to revitalize downtown areas?
options: Converting empty offices into apartments and co-working spaces
questions.explanation: 'They're converting empty office buildings into apartments, co-working spaces, and cultural centers'라는 문장에서 도시의 구체적인 행동을 설명하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the professor imply about cities that don't adapt quickly?
options: They will become more attractive to workers
They will benefit from lower property taxes
They will attract more remote workers
questions.explanation: 'Those that don't risk economic decline'에서 빠르게 적응하지 않는 도시의 위험성을 명확히 나타내고 있습니다.
